description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Cassiopeia''' launches her fangs at the target enemy that deal 52 – 120 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) magic damage. If this kills the target, ''Twin Fang's'' [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost is refunded.
description.text: Active: Cassiopeia launches her fangs at the target enemy that deal 52 – 120 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) magic damage. If this kills the target, Twin Fang's  mana cost is refunded.

description2.raw: Against a [[File:Poison icon.png|20px|link=Cassiopeia/LoL|An icon representing the keyword Poison]] [[:Cassiopeia/LoL|poisoned]] target, ''Twin Fang'' deals '''bonus''' magic damage and [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heals]] '''Cassiopeia'''. The heal is reduced by 75% against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] and small and medium [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description2.text: Against a poisoned target, Twin Fang deals bonus magic damage and heals Cassiopeia. The heal is reduced by 75% against minions and small and medium monsters.

notes.raw: * Upon reaching the target, ''Twin Fang'' will wait for an ongoing [[File:Cassiopeia Noxious Blast.png|20xpx|border|link=Cassiopeia#Noxious Blast|An icon for Cassiopeia's ability Noxious Blast]] [[Cassiopeia#Noxious Blast|Noxious Blast]] to explode before dealing its damage. * ''Twin Fang's'' damage against poisoned targets: ** When maxed first: 72 – 220 (based on level) (+ 65% AP). ** When maxed second: 72 – 220 (based on level) (+ 65% AP). ** When maxed last: 72 – 220 (based on level) (+ 65% AP). * ''Twin Fang's'' cast indicator is incorrectly adding her own radius to the range like an [[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] [[:Range|edge range]] ability, and is therefore slightly larger than the actual cast range ''Twin Fang'' can cast at. * Using ''Twin Fang'' on an out-of-range target after completing a movement order causes '''Cassiopeia''' to move back to her original location after casting, if no other order is issued during the entire process.(unexpected) ** This may be a consequence of ''Twing Fang'' being a "Walk in range of the target" ability that does not interrupt movement commands. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Upon reaching the target, Twin Fang will wait for an ongoing Noxious Blast to explode before dealing its damage.
Twin Fang's damage against poisoned targets:
* When maxed first: 72 – 220 (based on level) (+ 65% AP).
* When maxed second: 72 – 220 (based on level) (+ 65% AP).
* When maxed last: 72 – 220 (based on level) (+ 65% AP).
Twin Fang's cast indicator is incorrectly adding her own radius to the range like an edge range ability, and is therefore slightly larger than the actual cast range Twin Fang can cast at.
Using Twin Fang on an out-of-range target after completing a movement order causes Cassiopeia to move back to her original location after casting, if no other order is issued during the entire process.(unexpected)
* This may be a consequence of Twing Fang being a "Walk in range of the target" ability that does not interrupt movement commands.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
